strInstructionsDE: Schütteln Sie gemischten Scotch, Zitronensaft, Honigsirup und Ingwersirup mit Eis. Über großes Eis in gekühltem Rocks Glas abseihen. Geben Sie rauchigen Scotch darauf (verwenden Sie unbedingt einen rauchigen Scotch wie z.B. Islay Single Malt). Mit kandiertem Ingwer garnieren.
strInstructionsFR: Mélanger le scotch, le jus de citron, le sirop de miel et le sirop de gingembre avec de la glace. Filtrer sur une grande quantité de glace dans un verre à glace glacée. Faire flotter le scotch fumé sur le dessus (veiller à utiliser un scotch fumé tel qu'un single malt Islay). Décorer avec du gingembre confit.
strInstructionsIT:
Shakerare Scotch Blended, succo di limone, sciroppo di miele e sciroppo di zenzero con ghiaccio.
Filtrare con del ghiaccio in un bicchiere freddo.
Versa sopra il bicchiere uno scotch fumoso (assicurati di usare uno scotch affumicato come un single malt di Islay).
Guarnire con lo zenzero candito.

strInstructions: Vigorously shake and strain contents in a cocktail shaker with ice cubes, then pour into glass and garnish with bitters.
strInstructionsES: Agite vigorosamente y cuele el contenido en una coctelera con cubitos de hielo, luego viértalo en un vaso y decore con amargo.
strInstructionsDE: Den Inhalt in einem Cocktailshaker mit Eiswürfeln kräftig schütteln und abseihen, dann in ein Glas gießen und mit Bitter garnieren.
strInstructionsFR: Agiter vigoureusement et filtrer le contenu dans un shaker avec des glaçons, puis verser dans un verre et garnir de bitter.
strInstructionsIT: Shakerare vigorosamente e filtrare il contenuto in uno shaker con cubetti di ghiaccio, quindi versare in un bicchiere e guarnire con bitter.

reviews.comment: I've made it with & without the egg white & equally delicious. I used Elijah Craig bourbon based on a bartenders opinion that it pairs well with citrus. And after tasting it, goes well with Benedictine & lemon n lime, 4.5 stars.

Quite a nice sour and an easy variant on my usual regular whisky sour, but the benedictine was a bit overpowered by the citrus when I made this. Will try again but bumping the benedictine up to ~20mls.

(I should say I probably also like my sours a tiny bit sweeter than the Diffords recipes)

I replaced the sugar syrup with BG Reynolds Orgeat syrup. Makes a very subtle change. Nice. Worth doing a side by side comparison I think…. At least a gives me an excuse to have another of one this bloody lovely cocktail. Pretty much stripped my lemon tree shaking this baby up!
I have tried it , well the color was a bit darker. And I didn't manage to get a nice foam. Is it because i use egg white syrup ?
Fresh egg white, or pasteurised egg white that requires refrigeration to store, tends to produce more foam than pasteurised egg white that can be stored at ambient temp.
according to the video recipe ur written recipe is missing a few ingredients, Orange juice and orange bitters

The video wasn't wasn't of me or my recipe. I will have removed from page to save confusion. Your comment led me to remake the Frisco Sour and amend recipe and add notes re history. Thanks for bringing this cocktail to my attention.

strInstructions: Shake ingredients together in a mixer with ice. Strain into glass, garnish and serve.
strInstructionsDE: Die Zutaten in einem Mixer mit Eis verrühren. In ein Glas abseihen, garnieren und servieren.
strInstructionsIT:
Shakerare gli ingredienti insieme in un mixer con ghiaccio.
Filtrare nel bicchiere, guarnire e servire.

reviews.comment: Finally opened my new bottle of Rainwater Madeira. I believe I like the New York Flip or Coffee flip with tawny port better. Is there any reason this cocktail doesn't use a dry shake after the wet one?
It's an old recipe on our database that predated the dry shake. I've now specified this. Thanks for bringing to my attention.
Creamy, nutmeg on the nose. A little sour but it could be my medeira.

strInstructions: Mix with crushed ice in blender until smooth. Pour into chilled glass, garnish and serve.
strInstructionsES: Mezclar con hielo picado en la batidora hasta obtener una mezcla homogénea. Verter en un vaso frío, decorar y servir.
strInstructionsDE: Mit zerstoßenem Eis im Mixer mischen, bis es glatt ist. In ein gekühltes Glas geben, garnieren und servieren.
strInstructionsFR: Mélanger au mixeur avec de la glace pilée jusqu'à obtention d'un mélange homogène. Verser dans un verre réfrigéré, garnir et servir.
strInstructionsIT:
Mescolare con ghiaccio tritato in un frullatore fino a che liscio.
Versare in un bicchiere freddo, guarnire e servire.

reviews.comment: this one's really good. i bumped the rum up 75%, could definitely tolerate more. reminds me of a sweet tart or other sour candy. too sour for me so ill use less lime next time but thats normal
This one gets my wife's seal of approval - she likes a long fruity drink that's not too strong - pulled the Bacardi back to 1 shot but used 8 yr old to bring up the flavour. Added to her favourites
Oh and a luxardo maraschino cherry because why not???

I went a little off the rails here, but it was still delicious! Used Koloa brand dark rum instead of light, and lemon juice instead of lime. Otherwise the same! More of a almond pina sour than almond pina colada, but still sweet with tiki vibes! Excellent!

This one went from my Wish List to my Favourites. Wow. A great blend of cocktails. Sort of tiki, but not sweet. Perfect on a warm sunny afternoon. Would be great with grilled food or anything Mexican. Love it.
PS. Considering adding a 151 float next time for a little bit more punch.
A sort of mai tai pina colada cross over, what’s not to like? And easy to make

strInstructions: mix all ingredients into bowl keep iced stir frequently
strInstructionsES: mezclar todos los ingredientes en un bol mantener en hielo remover con frecuencia
strInstructionsDE: Alle Zutaten in die Schüssel geben und gleichmäßig rühren.
strInstructionsFR: Mélanger tous les ingrédients dans un bol et garder au frais en remuant fréquemment.
strInstructionsIT: mescolare tutti gli ingredienti nella ciotola, tenere la bevanda sempre fredda, mescolare spesso

reviews.comment: Used a nice cognac and Jamaican Black rum. Perfect for an after-dinner cocktail or evening sipper. Sort of a light version of an eggnog without the heavy eggy taste.
In true rum drinkers style, we decided that it needed just a wee jolt more. Added a 151 rum float. Brought the rum flavour forward. Certainly a good night cap. zzzzzzzz
The dark rum makes this version of the Milk Punch a fair bit more interesting than the standard Brandy Milk Punch. A bit sweeter, and even more dessert drink adjacent.

strInstructions: Mix up all ingredients with a cocktail stirrer and serve with crushed ice with mint and edible flour if available.
strInstructionsES: Mezcle todos los ingredientes con una coctelera y sirva con hielo picado con menta y harina comestible si está disponible.
strInstructionsDE: Alle Zutaten mit einem Cocktailrührer vermischen und mit zerstoßenem Eis mit Minze und Speisemehl (falls verfügbar) servieren.
strInstructionsFR: Mélangez tous les ingrédients avec un agitateur à cocktail et servez avec de la glace pilée avec de la menthe et de la farine comestible si disponible.
strInstructionsIT: Mescolare tutti gli ingredienti con un agitatore per cocktail e servire con ghiaccio tritato con menta e farina commestibile se disponibile.

reviews.comment: To me, this defines a "summer" cocktail. Nice and refreshing. Great combination of flavors and super easy to drink. Very nice.
It's very nice; smooth taste, fruity. Could do with a lemon or something to add some zing!

strInstructions: Served over ice in a tall glass with a popped cherry (can add more popped cherries if in the mood)!
strInstructionsES: Servido sobre hielo en un vaso alto con una cereza reventada (puede añadir más cerezas reventadas si le apetece).
strInstructionsDE: Serviert über Eis in einem hohen Glas mit einer entsteinten Kirsche (kann mehr entsteinte Kirschen hinzufügen, wenn sie in der Stimmung sind)!
strInstructionsFR: Servi sur glace dans un grand verre avec une cerise éclatée (on peut ajouter d'autres cerises éclatées si l'on est d'humeur) !
strInstructionsIT: Servito con ghiaccio in un bicchiere alto con una ciliegia snocciolata (puoi aggiungere più ciliegie snocciolata se ne hai voglia)!

strInstructions: Shake ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
strInstructionsDE: Die Zutaten mit Eis schütteln, in ein Cocktailglas abseihen und servieren.
strInstructionsIT: Shakerare gli ingredienti con ghiaccio, filtrare in una coppetta da cocktail e servire.

reviews.comment: Not enough raisin flavour IMO. Next time I will try using Pedro Jimenez sherry which tastes like syrupy raisins. The rosemary could be upped too.

I just have to comment on this one. I thought it was a BS recipe, and considered using Harvey's or a port instead of the raisins, but I religiously followed it to a T. The Rosemary is of course fantastic, and carries the drink. But the raisins are a nice background flavour that pairs well. Go easy on the sugar syrup, it could use a bit less. (Although this is #5 or Friday's Rosemary Sprig drinks and ratings weightings change as the day goes on)

strInstructions: Shake all ingredients (except nutmeg) with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.
strInstructionsDE: Alle Zutaten (außer Muskatnuss) mit Eis schütteln und in ein Whiskey-Sourglas abseihen. Muskatnuss darüber streuen und servieren.
strInstructionsIT: Shakerare tutti gli ingredienti (tranne la noce moscata) con ghiaccio e filtrare in un bicchiere da whisky sour. Cospargere di noce moscata e servire.

reviews.comment: Finally opened my new bottle of Rainwater Madeira. I believe I like the New York Flip or Coffee flip with tawny port better. Is there any reason this cocktail doesn't use a dry shake after the wet one?
It's an old recipe on our database that predated the dry shake. I've now specified this. Thanks for bringing to my attention.
Creamy, nutmeg on the nose. A little sour but it could be my medeira.

strInstructions: Pour all ingredients, except the bitters, into shaker filled with ice. Shake well. Pour into large glass, filled with ice. Add Angostura bitters, "on top". Garnish with cocktail cherry and pineapple.
strInstructionsES: Vierta todos los ingredientes, excepto el amargo, en una coctelera llena de hielo. Agitar bien. Verter en un vaso grande, lleno de hielo. Añada el amargo de Angostura "por encima". Decorar con cereza de cóctel y piña.
strInstructionsDE: Alle Zutaten, außer den Bitterstoffen, in einen mit Eis gefüllten Shaker geben. Gut schütteln. In ein großes, mit Eis gefülltes Glas gießen. Füge Angostura-Bitter hinzu, "on top". Mit Cocktailkirsche und Ananas garnieren.
strInstructionsFR: Verser tous les ingrédients, à l'exception des amers, dans un shaker rempli de glace. Bien agiter. Verser dans un grand verre rempli de glace. Ajouter l'Angostura bitters, "on top". Décorer avec une cerise cocktail et un ananas.
strInstructionsIT:
Versare tutti gli ingredienti, in uno shaker pieno di ghiaccio.
Agitare bene.
Versare in un bicchiere capiente, pieno di ghiaccio.
Guarnire con ananas.

reviews.comment:
Decided to try this using Pamplemousse liqueur instead of the Triple Sec. It was great. A little on the sour side, so others may want to add a small amount of simple syrup.
Strong grapefruit flavours with herbal hints from the vermouth.
It looks like a Pompanski Martini.
That's a great observation. I've added a link to the Pompanski Martini above.
Beautifully balanced (balances the books?)
Can you do this with lemon or lime juice instead?
Both lemon and lime are more acidic than grapefruit so you need a lot less. Would produce a very different cocktail.
This is a perfect afternoon or before-dinner cocktail. Wonderfully fruity, but still dry. Great hints on grapefruit.

strInstructions:
Rub the rim of each glass with lime slice and dip into salt.
Add ice, tequila, grapefruit juice, lime juice and top with pineapple soda.
Give it a quick stir.
Garnish with fresh pineapple or lime.
strInstructionsES:
Frote el borde de cada vaso con una rodaja de lima y sumérjalo en sal.
Añade hielo, tequila, zumo de pomelo, zumo de lima y completa con soda de piña.
Remover rápidamente.
Decorar con piña fresca o lima.
strInstructionsFR:
Frotter le bord de chaque verre avec une tranche de citron vert et le tremper dans du sel.
Ajoutez de la glace, de la tequila, du jus de pamplemousse, du jus de citron vert et complétez avec du soda à l'ananas.
Remuer rapidement.
Décorer avec de l'ananas ou du citron vert frais.
strInstructionsIT:
Strofina il bordo di ogni bicchiere con uno spicchio di lime e salalo.
Aggiungi ghiaccio, tequila, succo di pompelmo, succo di lime e aggiungi la soda all'ananas.
Dagli una rapida mescolata.
Guarnire con ananas fresco o lime.

reviews.comment: Tried the Bourbon version, with 3/4 lemon and 1/2 simple syrup rather than the 3/4 I saw online (the pineapple juice adds enough sweetness and body). Very nice! I'll try the Scotch version soon...
Used Johnnie Walker Black. Delicious smoky pineapple.
Not complex but the whisky (I used Shackleton Blended) gave it character. Easy to drink.
great very balanced cocktail !
2nd pineapple cocktail of the night, definitely much better. The malty backnote of the Scotch plays really well with the fruitiness of the pineapple.
My goodness this is a good drink. Used chivas 12 as blended scotch

strInstructions: Straight: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain in chilled martini cocktail glass. Cut passion fruit in half and use as garnish. Pour prosecco into a chilled shot glass and serve alongside the martini.
strInstructionsES: Directo: Vierta todos los ingredientes en un vaso mezclador con cubitos de hielo. Agite bien. Colar en una copa de cóctel de martini fría. Corta la maracuyá por la mitad y úsala como guarnición. Vierta el prosecco en un vaso de chupito frío y sírvalo junto con el martini.
strInstructionsDE: Pur: Alle Zutaten mit Eiswürfeln in ein Rührglas geben. Gut schütteln. In ein gekühltes Martini-Cocktailglas abseihen. Passionsfrucht halbieren und als Garnitur verwenden. Prosecco in ein gekühltes Schnapsglas füllen und zusammen mit dem Martini servieren.
strInstructionsFR: Droit : Versez tous les ingrédients dans un verre à mélange avec des glaçons. Bien agiter. Filtrer dans un verre à cocktail à martini réfrigéré. Coupez le fruit de la passion en deux et utilisez-le comme garniture. Versez le prosecco dans un verre à shot réfrigéré et servez avec le martini.
strInstructionsIT: Dritto: versare tutti gli ingredienti nel mixing glass con cubetti di ghiaccio. Agitare bene. Filtrare nella coppetta da cocktail Martini ghiacciata. Tagliate il frutto della passione a metà e usatelo come guarnizione. Versare il prosecco in un bicchierino ghiacciato e servire insieme al martini.

reviews.comment: Tast is a little artificial. It could be the taste of pink.
Can't really taste the passionfruit,but overall not a bad cocktail,could be drier.

strInstructions: Squeeze an orange and strain the juice. Put all the ingredients in a shaker filled with ice and shake for at least 12 seconds. Strain into a highball glass and decorate with a pineapple wedge or fruit of your choice.
strInstructionsES: Exprimir una naranja y colar el zumo. Poner todos los ingredientes en una coctelera con hielo y agitar durante al menos 12 segundos. Cuélalo en un vaso highball y decóralo con un trozo de piña o la fruta que prefieras.
strInstructionsDE: Eine Orange auspressen und den Saft abseihen. Alle Zutaten in einen mit Eis gefüllten Shaker geben und mindestens 12 Sekunden schütteln. In ein Longdrinkglas abseihen und mit einer Ananasscheibe oder Früchten Ihrer Wahl dekorieren.
strInstructionsFR: Presser une orange et filtrer le jus. Mettez tous les ingrédients dans un shaker rempli de glace et secouez pendant au moins 12 secondes. Filtrez dans un verre highball et décorez avec un quartier d'ananas ou un fruit de votre choix.
strInstructionsIT: Spremete un’arancia e filtratene il succo. Mettete tutti gli ingredienti in uno shaker colmo di ghiaccio e agitate per almeno 12 secondi. Versate filtrando in un bicchiere highball e decorate con uno spicchio d’ananas o frutta a piacere.

reviews.comment:
Decided to try this using Pamplemousse liqueur instead of the Triple Sec. It was great. A little on the sour side, so others may want to add a small amount of simple syrup.
Strong grapefruit flavours with herbal hints from the vermouth.
It looks like a Pompanski Martini.
That's a great observation. I've added a link to the Pompanski Martini above.
Beautifully balanced (balances the books?)
Can you do this with lemon or lime juice instead?
Both lemon and lime are more acidic than grapefruit so you need a lot less. Would produce a very different cocktail.
This is a perfect afternoon or before-dinner cocktail. Wonderfully fruity, but still dry. Great hints on grapefruit.

strInstructions: Pour carefully into a pousse-cafe glass, so that creme de menthe floats on grenadine. Serve without mixing.
strInstructionsDE: Vorsichtig in ein Pousse-Café-Glas gießen, damit die Creme de Menthe auf Grenadine schwimmt. Ohne zu mischen servieren.
strInstructionsIT: Versare con cura in un bicchiere pousse-cafè, in modo che la crema di menta galleggi sulla granatina. Servire senza mescolare.

strInstructions: Stir ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
strInstructionsDE: Zutaten mit Eis verrühren, in ein Cocktailglas abseihen und servieren.
strInstructionsIT: Mescolare gli ingredienti con ghiaccio, filtrare in una coppetta da cocktail e servire.

reviews.comment: Easy drinking, a bit thin though. It tastes primarily of cognac diluted with dry vermouth.. I added barspoon extra Triple Sec, it made it more interesting to my taste buds. Next time I will add one dash Peychau's bitter and one dash chocolate bitter to live up the cocktail.
Sooth and well balanced cocktail. Actually had this as a nightcap and it worked well also. Not sweet, but just a great, well-rounded cocktail.

strInstructions: Shake with ice.
strInstructionsES: Agitar con hielo.
strInstructionsDE: Mit Eis schütteln.
strInstructionsFR: Agiter avec de la glace.
strInstructionsIT: Shakerare con ghiaccio.

strInstructions: Shake well
strInstructionsES: Agitar bien
strInstructionsDE: Gut schütteln
strInstructionsFR: Bien agiter
strInstructionsIT: Versa in un bicchiere tutti gli ingredienti. Agitare bene

strInstructions: Pour all ingredients into a glass and stir. Garnish with half a passion fruit piece.
strInstructionsES: Vierta todos los ingredientes en un vaso y revuelva. Adorne con medio trozo de maracuyá.
strInstructionsDE: Alle Zutaten in ein Glas geben und umrühren. Mit einem halben Passionsfruchtstück garnieren.
strInstructionsFR: Versez tous les ingrédients dans un verre et remuez. Garnir d'un demi-morceau de fruit de la passion.
strInstructionsIT: Versare tutti gli ingredienti in un bicchiere e mescolare. Guarnire con mezzo pezzo di frutto della passione.

reviews.comment: Used (earl grey infused) Dolin dry in place of bianco as it was all I had - but an incredibly good drink. Perfect balance.

What a wonderful tribute to Paddington. It is perfect for his name. Used an organic orange marmalade which is not as sweet as many of the others in the stores. Loved the hint of orange in this Martini variation.

I made this with my own homemade seville orange marmalade, so was expecting great things! It was very nice, don't get me wrong, but the marmalade does dominate (which is maybe the point), but it did seem to rather undersell the pisco, which deserves a front and central role. Might be worth reversing the gin/pisco ratios? Just a thought...
Picked up some pisco and Bianco specifically to make this drink, and absolutely worth it! I love it! Thanks so much for sharing this one, Simon!
Great to hear Kevin. I remember cycling to Paddington station to find a bear to garnish this cocktail. One lost bear given a good home!

strInstructions: Throw everything into a blender and liquify.
strInstructionsES: Echar todo en una batidora y licuar.
strInstructionsDE: Alles in einen Mixer geben und aufschlagen.
strInstructionsFR: Mettre le tout dans un mixeur et liquéfier.
strInstructionsIT: Getta tutto in un frullatore e liquida.

reviews.comment: Made it with Plantation Pineapple Rum, instead of vodka, and that f**king works!!
Original recipe was too sweet and strong on the pineapple for my taste, so I added half oz. Of lemon juice and reduced the pineapple by the same measure. Liked it better

strInstructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the rum, Kahlua, and cream. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass and garnish with the nutmeg.
strInstructionsDE: In einem Shaker, der halb mit Eiswürfeln gefüllt ist, Rum, Kahlua und Sahne mischen. Gut schütteln. In ein Cocktailglas abseihen und mit der Muskatnuss garnieren.
strInstructionsIT: In uno shaker riempito a metà con cubetti di ghiaccio, unire il rum, il Kahlua e la panna. Filtrare in una coppetta da cocktail e guarnire con la noce moscata. Agitare bene.

reviews.comment: I wonder just shake pour all ingredients in shaker? or muddling mint first and shake?
Beneficial to bruise the mint first. Thanks for the suggestion; I've added it above.
It's a bit like a last word with mint substituting for the chartreuse
Really enjoyed this - I thought it would be too sweet for my tastes, but it was a very well balanced drink, all of the components contributing.

This is really nice. Everything is well-balanced; goes down real easy. The mint is really refreshing. I'm wondering if swapping the lemon for lime would give you a version of The Last Word with the mint replacing the Green Chartreuse... Will have to try that since GC is impossible to find these days.
Feels like a drink you can have anytime, really. The mint and the botanicals of the gin combine well, with the Maraschino providing a nice sweetness.
First one was by the book, second one was a, 2, 1, 1/2, 1//2 oz ratio and it worked better for me. Definitely will make again.
Nice fresh after dinner cocktail.
Substituted lime for lemon and used homemade mint infused simple syrup and Hendricks lunar gin, lovely.

strInstructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
strInstructionsDE: Alle Zutaten mit Eis schütteln, in ein Cocktailglas abseihen und servieren.
strInstructionsIT: Shakerare tutti gli ingredienti con ghiaccio, filtrare in una coppetta da cocktail e servire.

reviews.comment: Really nice and well balanced. Honey and calvados go well together.
Delightful cocktail. Flavours are subtle, but all work together very well. Champagne adds a nice soft touch.

strInstructions: In a shot glass add 1/3 Kahlua first. Then 1/3 Miduri, topping it off with a 1/3 bailey's irish cream
strInstructionsDE: In einem Schnapsglas zuerst 1/3 Kahlua geben. Dann 1/3 Miduri, ergänzt durch 1/3 Bailey's irish Cream.
strInstructionsIT:
In un bicchierino aggiungere prima 1/3 di Kahlua.
Quindi 1/3 di Midori, completando con 1/3 di crema irlandese di bailey

strInstructions: Simply add the orange juice, quite a quick pour in order to mix the sambucca with the orange juice. The juice MUST have fruit pulp!
strInstructionsES: Basta con añadir el zumo de naranja, vertiendo bastante rápido para mezclar la sambucca con el zumo de naranja. ¡El zumo DEBE tener pulpa de fruta!
strInstructionsDE: Einfach den Orangensaft zugeben und ganz schnell gießen, um den Sambucca mit dem Orangensaft zu mischen. Der Saft MUSS Fruchtfleisch enthalten!
strInstructionsFR: Ajouter simplement le jus d'orange, en versant assez rapidement afin de mélanger la sambucca au jus d'orange. Le jus DOIT contenir de la pulpe de fruit !
strInstructionsIT:
Basta aggiungere il succo d'arancia, abbastanza veloce per amalgamare la sambuca con il succo d'arancia.
Il succo deve avere polpa di frutta!

strInstructions: Pour red wine and grenadine into a collins glass over ice cubes. Fill with lemon-lime soda, stir, and serve.
strInstructionsES: Verter el vino tinto y la granadina en un vaso collins sobre cubitos de hielo. Rellenar con refresco de lima-limón, remover y servir.
strInstructionsDE: Rotwein und Grenadine in ein Collins-Glas über Eiswürfel gießen. Mit Zitronen-Limetten-Soda auffüllen, umrühren und servieren.
strInstructionsFR: Verser le vin rouge et la grenadine dans un verre Collins sur des glaçons. Remplir de soda au citron vert, remuer et servir.
strInstructionsIT: Versare il vino rosso e la granatina in un bicchiere Collins sopra i cubetti di ghiaccio.Riempi con la soda al limone e lime, mescola e servi.

reviews.comment: This is delicious, and I am surprised it has not received a higher rating.
This was my favourite cocktail at The Portobello Star. So pleased to have found a recipe and shall be making this my Christmas drink.
This is marvellous as an aperitif and I am surprised that it’s not been commented on yet.

strInstructions: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
strInstructionsDE: Alle Zutaten mit Eis verrühren, in ein Cocktailglas abseihen und servieren.
strInstructionsIT: Mescolare tutti gli ingredienti con ghiaccio, filtrare in una coppetta da cocktail e servire.

reviews.comment: A less aggressive and assertively dry martini, possibly for those who find them a bit raw, but still with a nice touch of bitterness on the finish With so few ingredients their respective qualities will be very evident of course. Very nice and refreshing cocktail.
Cognac version was also very nice. Bumped up the spirit to 45ml, split the vermouth equally between Dolin and carpano. Orange twist. A very pleasant night cap!
Pour all equal quantities of the same ingredients and it's basically a Poet's Dream, no?
Yes, indeed, the same three ingredients in different proportions. I've added links between the to cocktails. Thanks for bringing to my attention.
Lovely cocktail to toast Queen Elizabeth II on Feb 6, 2023 and watch The Crown.
Made the brandy variation with 50/50 Grand Marnier/Triple Sec in place of the Orange Curacao. A rich, smooth, boozy sipper. The variation worthy of it's own page.

I made the gin variation with Greenalls London gin and Noilly Prat vermouth. As a fan of gin martinis this had a certain very welcome ‘je ne sais quoi’ with the addition of Benedictine. Very nice. Can see this becoming a regular choice.
I made the brandy variation. Very smooth. A fine, dignified toast to our Queen.
Nice drink! Although, given its gin-heavy vibes, it should probably be named for her mother ?
But her mother was also Queen Elizabeth so maybe it is!
Did not have the ingredients to make a Dubonnet, so I looked for a cocktail to make in HM QE II's honor on this day.

strInstructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
strInstructionsDE: Alle Zutaten mit Eis schütteln, in ein Cocktailglas abseihen und servieren.
strInstructionsIT: Shakerare tutti gli ingredienti con ghiaccio, filtrare in una coppetta da cocktail e servire.

reviews.comment: Waiting for my new bottle of avallen to arrive so I can try this!
Liked this with Dubonnet, an orange twist and on the rocks - it’s rather like a green apple Negroni!
Worth the wait. It's delicious.
This is a great cocktail! I will add this to my list of favorites.
Like an apple brandy-laced Martinez, with the orange influences exchanged for the complex herbs of Chartreuse. Wonderful as a nightcap; though only a bar spoon, the liqueur adds a lot.
Very nice after dinner cocktail. This is a true sipper. Love the touch of Chartreuse.
This was outstanding. Great balance. The Chartreuse added to the herbal flavours in the gin. Just sweet enough to be a perfect aperitif.
Solid five! May add a plus to that with the right vermouth. Made mine with Antica Formula. Looking forward to alternatives. Will try it without the Chartreuse. Maybe.

strInstructions: Stir all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.
strInstructionsDE: Alle Zutaten mit Eis verrühren, in ein Cocktailglas abseihen und servieren.
strInstructionsIT: Mescolare tutti gli ingredienti con ghiaccio, filtrare in una coppetta da cocktail e servire.

reviews.comment: This is a true after-dinner cocktail. Found it a bit on the sweet side, but very flavourful. Wonderful winter flavours and perfect for a late Christmas Eve cocktail.

Another great cocktail to showcase Pedro Ximénez sherry. This one benefits from a balancing bit of sour and subtle orange zest flavor but mostly all the underlying complexity of the sherry's maturation process. I made mine with Plantation Three Star and Mil Pesetas.

strInstructions: Shake together in a cocktail shaker, then strain into chilled glass. Garnish and serve.
strInstructionsDE: In einem Cocktailshaker vermengen und dann in ein gekühltes Glas abseihen. Garnieren und servieren.
strInstructionsIT:
Shakerare insieme in uno shaker, quindi filtrare in un bicchiere freddo.
Guarnire e servire.

reviews.comment: What a great cocktail. Was not quite sure of the ingredients, and concerned it may be sweet. It is very smooth and well balanced. A great cocktail for before dinner.
Dangerously beyond sippable - nice sweetness and aroma. I had to sub kirsch and used 1 oz. of orange blossom vodka and 1/4 oz. of Maraschino liqueur. Mine was much more rosy than the picture.
Very different. Definitely tasting the kirschwasser. Pairs nicely with the grenadine. Dried slightly and with a hint of salinity from using Noilly Prat.
No grenadine available, substituted cherry syrup from cocktail cherries.

strInstructions: Pour beer into large mug, slowly add the 7-up (or Sprite).
strInstructionsES: Vierte la cerveza en una jarra grande y añade lentamente la 7-up (o Sprite).
strInstructionsDE: Bier in einen großen Becher gießen, langsam den 7-up (oder Sprite) hinzufügen.
strInstructionsFR: Verser la bière dans une grande chope et ajouter lentement le 7-up (ou le Sprite).
strInstructionsIT: Versare la birra in una tazza grande, aggiungere lentamente il 7up (o Sprite).

reviews.comment: Too much sugar for my taste. I used an amber lager and a Pils or Helles immediately seemed like a much better choice.

That's a somewhat strange way to make a cocktail out of a very basic drink. The traditional way to make a Radler in Germany is to simply use half Pilsner and half Sprite. No ice needed and serve in a pint glass.

strInstructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the rum, lemon juice, and sugar. Shake well. Strain into a sour glass and garnish with the orange slice and the cherry.
strInstructionsDE: In einem Shaker, der halb mit Eiswürfeln gefüllt ist, Rum, Zitronensaft und Zucker vermengen. Gut schütteln. In ein Sourglas abseihen und mit der Orangenscheibe und der Kirsche garnieren.
strInstructionsIT: In uno shaker riempito a metà con cubetti di ghiaccio, unire il rum, il succo di limone e lo zucchero. Agitare bene. Filtrare in un bicchiere sour e guarnire con la fetta d'arancia e la ciliegia.

reviews.comment: The system here suggested my Hamilton 151 (eye roll) for the float, and it obliterated the egg foam. The drink wasn't bad with it, and I was pleased it wasn't all that sweet. Maybe something to revisit to test different rum combos.

Being a big rum drinker was looking forward to this, but found it just OK. Nice but was a bit underwhelmed with this cocktail. Agreed with Andre that it needed more aged rum. Seemed to work a bit better mixing in the overproof rum to add some depth of flavour to the cocktail. Did drink the full cocktail, but there are other rum cocktails much better.
Liked it better with a full shot of aged rum!

strInstructions: Mix all ingredients in a punch bowl and serve.
strInstructionsES: Mezclar todos los ingredientes en una ponchera y servir.
strInstructionsDE: Alle Zutaten in einer Bowle mischen und servieren.
strInstructionsFR: Mélanger tous les ingrédients dans un bol à punch et servir.
strInstructionsIT: Mescolare tutti gli ingredienti in una ciotola da punch e servire.

reviews.comment: Probably the best and one of the simplest cocktails of all time. Absolutely divine flavour, this takes you off to an evening on the beach where ever you are.
Meant to add - you can shake the nuts off this and make it a tall drink and the rum still cuts thru
Used 2/3 White overproof Wray and Nephew and 1/3 Lemon Hart 151 Demerara. Wow. Big rum punch (no pun intended).
So, effectively, a daiquiri w/ ango on the rocks...

Fantastic - I used Wray & Nephew Navy Strength (one of my favorites) - this cocktail allows the highlights of the rum to shine while boosting the sweetness and a bit of citrus as well. Excellent cocktail - highly recommended!!
Oops - I meant Smith & Cross Navy Strength, not Wray & Nephew - sorry for any confusion this may have caused.

Made this with 45 ml Wray & Nephew, 15 ml lime juice, 30 ml 2:1 sugar syrup, 24 drops Angostura, 60 ml chilled water. Very tasty. The lime, sugar, bitters, & water help soften the edges of the rum without taking center stage. Very flavorful. Seems like a great option for introducing someone to Wray & Nephew. Also seems great for a hot summer day!

Finally gave this a shot after having it on my list for a while. I think the fact that it's diluted with so much water initially made me hesitant but I gotta say, this was fantastic. I upped the rum to 2 oz and added about 1/4 oz of allspice dram on my second pour and that was great, as well. It doesn't taste diluted it's just a refreshing long drink with a ton of flavor. My new go-to when I need to whip up something easy that still tastes great.
Really nice, I like all the punch recipe's though. For me 2 dashes angostura is was too much for the wray & Nephew I used for te drink. Next time I will put 1 dash in.
Brilliant, thanks Simon.

Replacing the screwtop on a bitters bottle with a Dartdash does expose the bitters to oxygenation and will accelerate the evaporation of alcohol. If using a bottle in a few months then not an issue. Otherwise, perhaps replace the screwcap between uses. (If you do use a Dartdash then use a knife to prise out the plastic dasher insert in the bottle.)
Would this work as well with a normal strength white rum or does this have to be overproof?
You'd have to massively up the volume of the rum but it's not just the balance of alcohol to other ingredients, it's the flavour that overproof rum provides that makes the drink.

strInstructions: Dissolve powdered sugar in water in an old-fashioned glass. Add rum and one ice cube and stir. Add the twist of lemon peel and serve.
strInstructionsES: Disuelva el azúcar en polvo en agua en un vaso old-fashioned. Añada el ron y un cubito de hielo y remueva. Añada el toque de piel de limón y sirva.
strInstructionsDE: Puderzucker in Wasser in einem old-fashioned Glas auflösen. Rum und einen Eiswürfel dazugeben und umrühren. Die Zitronenschale hinzufügen und servieren.
strInstructionsFR: Dissoudre le sucre en poudre dans l'eau dans un verre à l'ancienne. Ajouter le rhum et un glaçon et remuer. Ajouter le zeste de citron et servir.
strInstructionsIT: Sciogliere lo zucchero in acqua in un bicchiere vecchio stile. Aggiungere il rum e un cubetto di ghiaccio e mescolare. Aggiungere la scorza di limone e servire

reviews.comment: interesting way to dress up some milk
Great milk cocktail that's not overly sweet. Seems like you could have some fun trying it with different funky Jamaican rums.

strInstructions: Shake all ingredients (except cola) with ice and strain into a chilled collins glass. Fill with cola and serve.
strInstructionsES: Agitar todos los ingredientes (excepto la cola) con hielo y colar en un vaso Collins frío. Rellenar con cola y servir.
strInstructionsDE: Alle Zutaten (außer Cola) mit Eis schütteln und in ein gekühltes Collins-Glas abseihen. Mit Cola auffüllen und servieren.
strInstructionsFR: Secouer tous les ingrédients (sauf le cola) avec de la glace et filtrer dans un verre Collins réfrigéré. Remplir de cola et servir.
strInstructionsIT: Shakerare tutti gli ingredienti (tranne la cola) con ghiaccio e filtrare in un bicchiere collins freddo. Riempi con cola e servi

reviews.comment: Ah the controversial Golden Fizz. I could not taste egg in the final drink, which is pretty good. Lemon, sugar, juniper from the gin with just a tiny richness.

Simple delivery of cheer at its most 'refined'? Lemon meringue-smeared, semi-diluted gin?... The aftertaste is mildly amusing, but way more interesting than any sip... I drink to explore flavors, and this drink is intentionally trying to tittilate and tease. (4 Jan 2023, 6:44a)

strInstructions: Pour the rum and soda into a collins glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well and garnish with the lemon wedge.
strInstructionsES: Vierta el ron y la soda en un vaso collins casi lleno de cubitos de hielo. Remover bien y decorar con la rodaja de limón.
strInstructionsDE: Den Rum und das Soda in ein Collins-Glas gießen, das fast mit Eiswürfeln gefüllt ist. Gut umrühren und mit dem Zitronenkeil garnieren.
strInstructionsFR: Verser le rhum et le soda dans un verre Collins presque rempli de glaçons. Bien mélanger et décorer avec le quartier de citron.
strInstructionsIT: Versare il rum e la soda in un bicchiere Collins quasi pieno di cubetti di ghiaccio. Mescolate bene e guarnite con lo spicchio di limone

reviews.comment: Nothing too special, but a nice option when you need something light, citrus-y and refreshing.

Where I come from, the oranges are hit-and-miss - you get very sweet oranges and horrendously sour ones, often in the same batch!. So I use San Pellegrino Limonata if I have sweet oranges and Sprite if the oranges are the mouth-puckering type. Works every time.
A little on the sweet side, but very enjoyable. Nice citrus and rum hints. We used 1/2 white and 1/2 gold rum. Was perfect on a hot evening with a spicy dinner.

strInstructions: Mix all ingredients in glass & add ice.
strInstructionsES: Mezcle todos los ingredientes en un vaso y añada hielo.
strInstructionsDE: Alle Zutaten in einem Glas mischen und Eis hinzufügen.
strInstructionsFR: Mélanger tous les ingrédients dans un verre et ajouter de la glace.
strInstructionsIT: Versare gli ingredienti sul ghiaccio e mescolare.

reviews.comment:
I have had a Rum Runner in many of the existing tiki bars in California. I also have many vintage tiki cocktail books and this recipe is the same (or similar) to those recipes.
As with most tiki cocktails, I find them a bit sweet. We added a Demerara 151 float. Lessened the sweetness and added a bit more of the rum kick.
Couldn’t really get on with the blackberry. Removed, and replaced with 15ml of a creamy banana liqueur I had on hand. A dusting of grated nutmeg works well.
Nix the grenadine. Reduce the pineapple to 45 ml, the banana liqueur to 22.5 ml. Add two dashes of Peychaud's bitters. There it is! Enjoy.
I honed this down to taste better and fit in a Collins glass. Crushed ice may dilute this to death. If so, then add a little sweetener to drive it.

I made this drink according to these directions, and it came out a little sweet but still very enjoyable. I think it made a difference that I used fresh pressed pineapple juice from a pineapple that I cut up immediately before I made the drink.
A bit too sweet for me. I might skip the grenadine next time, and maybe swap the blackberry liqueur for unsweetened cranberry juice.

Pretty good, but I felt like it was a bit of an in-betweener. Next time I will add more blackberry to see if that tips it in the direction that I was hoping for. Not a bad drink, just not my favorite.
I made it : 1oz Cargo Cult Banana Rum, 1oz dark rum, 1 oz pineapple juice, 1 oz creme de cassis, 1 oz orange juice, 0.5 oz grenadine and 0.5 oz 55% rum
When the sunshine arrives this is my goto and its easily customisable to whatever you have in the cabinet.

strInstructions: Pour the Scotch and Drambuie into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well. Garnish with the lemon twist.
strInstructionsES: Vierta el whisky y el Drambuie en un vaso old-fashioned casi lleno de cubitos de hielo. Remover bien. Decorar con el twist de limón.
strInstructionsDE: Gießen Sie den Scotch und die Drambuie in ein old-fashioned Glas, das fast mit Eiswürfeln gefüllt ist. Gut umrühren. Mit der Zitronenscheibe garnieren.
strInstructionsFR: Verser le Scotch et le Drambuie dans un verre à l'ancienne presque rempli de glaçons. Bien mélanger. Décorer avec le zeste de citron.
strInstructionsIT: Versare lo Scotch e il Drambuie in un bicchiere vecchio stile quasi riempito di cubetti di ghiaccio. Guarnire con la scorza di limone. Mescolare bene.

reviews.comment: I recommend to try it by replacing Scotch with Rye. 2:1 Rye:Drambuie +2 dash Angostura Bitters; just perfect!
Did not try the cocktail (no Drambuie available), but what in the world is the picture? How would it be possible to get pink on a Rusty Nail? Hilarious to me!
I am sure that is just lighting. ?
We do like to amuse! Obviously, wrong image has replaced the original. Please bear with us. That said, adding bitters will colour, more the wrong glass and garnish that troubles me.

Love Rusty nails.
I have tried this drink with many different types of scotch and found the Dalmore Port Wood the best for the mix. It adds a nice exotic oaky aroma to it.
Yes at 4:1. The perfect nightcap. Used to drink these with the other bartenders after our shift.
Great cocktail. We did it 4:1 to keep the sweetness down.
I like to use Johnnie Walker Black for these.
My sweet palate prefers a 50/50 mix for this perfect winter drink.
50/50 is my preference too. It's also a great way to introduce whisky to those who struggle with drinking it neat.
4:1 or higher seems better. Or it’s too sweet and cloying

strInstructions: One shot each, shake n shoot
strInstructionsES: Un disparo cada uno, agitar y disparar
strInstructionsDE: Jeweils ein Shot, schütteln und schießen.
strInstructionsFR: Un coup chacun, shake n shoot
strInstructionsIT: Versa in un bicchiere tutti gli ingredienti. Mescolare.

reviews.comment:
As a Canadian, I've had my fair share of Caesars (Bloody Mary's, with Clamato), but this must be my first with gin. I am pleasantly impressed. I think the sugar is necessary, though I would add more lemon.
Usually, I toss the squeezed wedge into the drink.
A lime wedge would indeed add to flavour and appearance. Thanks, Michael.

This was fantastic. And I would agree with other expressing the sentiment that sugar (syrup) is not necessary for this (at least at this measure). I was in the same boat as Jesse M in that I had all of these ingredients at hand. Trying to clear out my supplies. Not a major deviation on my own recipe for a Bloody Mary, but this was still a winner. (9 Oct 2022, 3:07a)

Yeah, hmm... Made it again right after the first attempt... While the sans-sugar is better, it might need a boost from spice and/or citrus... This is one of them ongoing artistic pursuits haha. Never be perfection.

Just made this given Difford's rating and the fact I happened to have every ingredient luring around...and was pleasantly surprised. Did not expect to enjoy it as much as I did, especially after accidentally adding a bit too much Tabasco (not a spice fan!). Will have to make this again with a meal soon
Hi Jesse. Thanks for bringing to my attention. Indeed, like the Bloody Mary, this cocktail is better 'rolled' rather than shaken. I've amended "How to make" accordingly.
After reading up on the rolling technique, is there any reason this variant is shaken and not rolled?
Tried with freshly juiced tomatoes (as opposed to tomato juice) and it’s fabulously light and refreshing. Recommended.
Omitted the sugar, slightly upped the juice - tasty!
Agreed - there’s no need for sugar. Perfect flight on a plane, when your taste buds are dulled
Tastes even better than a Bloody Mary! Perfect for brunch.

strInstructions: Into a shot glass layer the Crown Royal on top of the Frangelico.
strInstructionsDE: In einem Schnapsglas die Crown Royal auf den Frangelico schichten.
strInstructionsIT: In un bicchiere da shot versa a strati prima il Frangelico e infine il Crown Royal

reviews.comment: You can't go wrong with mint and champagne! What a great Mojito twist. Love it.
My favourite cocktail, perhaps because it’s what my fiancé and I drank to celebrate our engagement in Paris in Cafe Panis overlooking Notre Dame. FYI it’s lethal on an empty stomach, be warned!
Very good high-end mojito. Champaign adds an interesting touch.
This is really lovely, though I do recommend slapping the mint before adding to the glass and muddling with the simple syrup and lime juice to bring out even more mint flavor.

strInstructions: Pour all the ingredients into tumbler over ice. Strain into glass.
strInstructionsES: Vierta todos los ingredientes en un vaso con hielo. Colar en un vaso.
strInstructionsDE: Alle Zutaten über Eis in den Becher gießen. In ein Glas abseihen.
strInstructionsFR: Verser tous les ingrédients dans un tumbler avec des glaçons. Filtrer dans un verre.
strInstructionsIT: Versare tutti gli ingredienti nel tumbler sul ghiaccio. Filtrare nel bicchiere.

reviews.comment: Lovely. I added 1.25ml of maraschino syrup.

Toast to the Queen
Lovely cocktail
Wonderful cocktail. Toasted the Queen on her birthday.

strInstructions: In an old-fashioned glass, dissolve the sugar in the club soda. Add crushed ice until the glass is almost full. Add the rum. Stir well. Garnish with the cherry and the orange and lemon slices.
strInstructionsES: En un vaso old-fashioned, disuelva el azúcar en la soda. Añada hielo picado hasta que el vaso esté casi lleno. Añada el ron. Remover bien. Decorar con la cereza y las rodajas de naranja y limón.
strInstructionsDE: In einem old-fashioned Glas den Zucker in der Soda auflösen. Füge zerstoßenes Eis hinzu, bis das Glas fast voll ist. Den Rum hinzufügen. Gut umrühren. Mit der Kirsche und den Orangen- und Zitronenscheiben garnieren.
strInstructionsFR: Dans un verre à l'ancienne, dissoudre le sucre dans le club soda. Ajouter de la glace pilée jusqu'à ce que le verre soit presque plein. Ajouter le rhum. Bien mélanger. Décorer avec la cerise et les tranches d'orange et de citron.
strInstructionsIT: In un bicchiere vecchio stile, sciogli lo zucchero nella soda club. Aggiungere il ghiaccio tritato fino a quando il bicchiere è quasi pieno. Aggiungi il rum. Guarnire con la ciliegia e le fettine di arancia e limone. Mescolare bene.

reviews.comment: Love the Angostura on the nose with every sip.
Not bad but being Angostura Bitter's Birthday, I'm surprised you didn't choose a Trinidad Sour as the cocktail of the day for such occasion ( 1.5 oz/45 mls vs 1 dash of Angostura) ;)
The choice was due to the extra dashes used in the garnish so the aromatics and visual appearance of bitters are made obvious to the drinker.

strInstructions: Pour gin and cranberry into a highball filled with ice cubes. Add grenadine and stir.
strInstructionsDE: Gießen Sie Gin und Cranberry in einen mit Eiswürfeln gefüllten Highball. Grenadine zugeben und umrühren.
strInstructionsIT:
Versa gin e mirtilli rossi in un highball pieno di cubetti di ghiaccio.
Aggiungere la granatina e mescolare.

strInstructions: Mix sugar syrup with lemon juice in a tall glass. Fill up with ginger ale.
strInstructionsES: Mezcle el jarabe de azúcar con el zumo de limón en un vaso alto. Rellenar con ginger ale.
strInstructionsDE: Zuckersirup mit Zitronensaft in einem hohen Glas mischen. Mit Ginger Ale auffüllen.
strInstructionsFR: Mélanger le sirop de sucre et le jus de citron dans un grand verre. Remplir de ginger ale.
strInstructionsIT: Mescolare lo sciroppo di zucchero con il succo di limone in un bicchiere alto.Riempi di ginger ale.

strInstructions:
1) Add the Bombay Sapphire, Blue Curacao, rosemary sprig and gently squeezed lemon wedge to a balloon glass. Swirl well to combine.
2) Fill with cubed ice and top with the Fever-Tree Light Tonic Water.
3) Gently fold with a bar spoon to mix.
strInstructionsES:
1) Agregue Bombay Sapphire, Blue Curacao, una ramita de romero y una rodaja de limón suavemente exprimida a una copa tipo globo. Agite bien para combinar.
2) Llénelo con cubitos de hielo y cubra con el agua tónica ligera Fever-Tree.
3) Incorporar suavemente con una cuchara de bar para mezclar.
strInstructionsDE: Fügen Sie den Bombay Saphir, Blauen Curacao, Rosmarinzweig und den sanft ausgedrückten Zitronenkeil in ein Ballonglas ein. Gut mischen. Mit Eiswürfel füllen und mit dem Fever-Tree Light Tonic Water auffüllen. Vorsichtig mit einem Barlöffel zum Mischen verrühren.
strInstructionsIT:
1) Aggiungere il Bombay Sapphire, il Blue Curacao, il rametto di rosmarino e uno spicchio di limone leggermente spremuto in un bicchiere a palloncino.
Agita bene per combinare.
2) Riempire con ghiaccio a cubetti e ricoprire con l'acqua tonica Fever-Tree Light.
3) Piegare delicatamente con un cucchiaio da bar per mescolare.

reviews.comment: I like the base concept of this maybe... Use what you got, ok... Why one would use that much aperitivo AND that scant amount of maraschino?... It amounts to selling the drink?... Paper Plane is great; Division Bell I desire less sweetness... But this just skews in the opposite direction of being too bitter, biting, and brash... adjustments must be made compadres...
It's good, just it isn't quite as complex as e.g. a Paper plane.

strInstructions:
Prepare all the ingredients on the counter to be able to work well and quickly, especially the cream and egg white.

Pour all the ingredients into a shaker.

Shake vigorously for 1 minute: cream and egg white must be mixed perfectly, so don't rush.

Now open the shaker and put some ice and shake for 1-2 minutes. It depends on how long you can resist!

Pour into a highball glass, add a splash of soda and garnish to taste.

Ramos Gin Fizz was once drunk as an invigorating drink or even as a breakfast, try it as an aperitif and after dinner and you will discover a little gem now lost.
strInstructionsES:
Preparar todos los ingredientes en la encimera para poder trabajar bien y rápido, especialmente la nata y la clara de huevo.

Vierta todos los ingredientes en una coctelera.

Agita enérgicamente durante 1 minuto: la nata y la clara de huevo deben mezclarse perfectamente, así que no tengas prisa.

Ahora abre la coctelera, pon un poco de hielo y agita durante 1-2 minutos. Depende de cuánto tiempo puedas resistir.

Vierte en un vaso highball, añade un chorrito de soda y adorna al gusto.

El Gin Fizz de Ramos se tomaba antiguamente como bebida tonificante o incluso como desayuno, pruébelo como aperitivo y después de cenar y descubrirá una pequeña joya hoy perdida.
strInstructionsDE:
Bereiten Sie alle Zutaten auf der Theke vor, um gut und schnell arbeiten zu können, insbesondere die Sahne und das Eiweiß.
Alle Zutaten, bis auf das Soda, in einen Shaker geben.
1 Minute kräftig schütteln: Sahne und Eiweiß müssen sich perfekt vermischen, also keine Eile.
Jetzt den Shaker öffnen und etwas Eis hinzugeben und 1-2 Minuten schütteln. Es kommt darauf an, wie lange du widerstehen kannst!
In ein Longdrinkglas gießen, einen Spritzer Soda hinzugeben und nach Belieben garnieren.
Ramos Gin Fizz wurde einst als belebendes Getränk oder sogar als Frühstück getrunken, probieren Sie es als Aperitif und nach dem Abendessen und Sie werden ein kleines Juwel entdecken, das jetzt verloren gegangen ist.
strInstructionsFR:
Préparer tous les ingrédients sur le comptoir pour pouvoir travailler bien et rapidement, surtout la crème et le blanc d'œuf.

Verser tous les ingrédients dans un shaker.

Agiter vigoureusement pendant 1 minute : la crème et le blanc d'œuf doivent être parfaitement mélangés, ne pas se précipiter.

Ouvrez ensuite le shaker, mettez de la glace et secouez pendant 1 à 2 minutes. Tout dépend de votre capacité à résister !

Versez dans un verre highball, ajoutez un trait de soda et décorez selon votre goût.

Le Ramos Gin Fizz était autrefois bu comme une boisson revigorante ou même comme un petit-déjeuner. Essayez-le en apéritif et après le dîner et vous découvrirez un petit bijou aujourd'hui perdu.
strInstructionsIT:
Preparate tutti gli ingredienti sul bancone per poter lavorare bene e velocemente, soprattutto la panna e l’albume d’uovo.
Versate tutti gli ingredienti, a parte la soda, in uno shaker.
Agitate energicamente per 1 minuto: panna ed albume si devono mescolare alla perfezione, quindi non abbiate fretta.
Adesso aprite lo shaker e mettete un po’ di ghiaccio e agitate per 1-2 minuti. Dipende da quanto riuscite a resistere!
Versate in un bicchiere highball, aggiungete uno schizzo di soda e guarnite a piacere.
Una volta il Ramos Gin Fizz era bevuto come drink corroborante o addirittura come colazione, provatelo come aperitivo e nel dopo cena e scoprirete un piccolo gioiello ormai perduto.

reviews.comment: I found this one in famous New Orleans drinks and how to mix em, it’s fab!
Be great to get a video of Simon demoing this! As a relative newbie I think it would really help getting the seeing the technique with this!
Despite my hatred of being in front of a camera, I will get around to making some videos and the Ramos will be near the top of the list.
If you don't use old tom gin for this, could you balance it out with additional syrup? Or is there some other factor at play?
Old Tom gin has some sweetness, but it also has more pronounced botanicals.

I got 2/3rd of the way making a Ramos tonight after my final shaking (I dry shake last, after a 40~g ice-fully-melted shake), only to realize I was out of soda water. There's no going back - so browsing my fridge for anything carbonated, I picked a can of Fever Tree Ginger Beer. And know what? Not bad! Makes sense it would taste alright - kind of a cross between a Gin Gin Mule, minus the mint? Maybe I'll use ginger syrup or muddle a touch of ginger next time? Salvaged all my shaking at least!

I have now twice added 10 ml of Triple sec and I think this drink gets even better. I have even tried the original at a world top-50 bar! I know it is a sacrilege to alter a classic drink like this. But the lemon/lime/orange water/vanilla-mix just loves triple sec in my opinion.

It's simple and delicious. It's a lot of shaking but it's worth it. I did find judging how much soda water to add a bit awkward as I didn't know how much volume I'd get when pouring both into a glass.

Ended up with an utter fail. The cream seemed to split, so the cocktail ended up with foam and then a layer redolent of a standard drink, rather than a fluffy cloud. The taste was too tart with no balance whatsoever. It ended up being limp, with no creaminess or smoothness. Anybody could provide some insight so that I can do it correctly next time? I shaked for 40 seconds, then reverse dry shook it for 1.5 minutes.
@Daisy Gammon I'll try it the next time I have cream (and the courage!).
Sorry I meant try first 7 ingredients then add cream ect…

The best cocktail. Took a lot of practice to get this one spot on, but worth the effort. The only tip missing in the recipe is to poke a hole in the middle of the meringue, after it's rested in the fridge for a few minutes, and use that hole to shortly pour the remaining cocktail in to get it to raise.

strInstructions: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.
strInstructionsDE: Alle Zutaten (außer kohlensäurehaltigem Wasser) mit Eis schütteln und über zwei Eiswürfel in ein Highball-Glas sieben. Mit kohlensäurehaltigem Wasser auffüllen, umrühren und servieren.
strInstructionsIT: Shakerare tutti gli ingredienti (eccetto l'acqua gassata) con ghiaccio e filtrare in un bicchiere highball su due cubetti di ghiaccio. Riempi con acqua gassata, mescola e servi
